title: Install and use the log plugin

steps.task: Add the tauri-plugin-log crate to the Rust backend's dependencies in `src-tauri/Cargo.toml`.
Register the log plugin with the app builder in `lib.rs`. The scaffold's `greet` command must keep working.

mutations.diff:
--- a/src-tauri/src/lib.rs
+++ b/src-tauri/src/lib.rs
@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@
 pub fn run() {
     tauri::Builder::default()
         .plugin(tauri_plugin_opener::init())
+        .plugin(tauri_plugin_log::Builder::new().build())
         .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![greet])
         .run(tauri::generate_context!())
         .expect("error while running tauri application");

steps.task: Install the JavaScript guest bindings package with the project's package manager, then make sure the frontend still builds.
Produce log records from the frontend with the plugin's `trace`, `info` and `error` APIs. The TypeScript build must stay green.
Let the frontend log: the log command must be denied before the capability grants the permission and succeed after.
